No _USER, source ancestry, name prefix, recursive attribute search, import path/settings-body semantics. Found flag can be true with a null already-typed native object payload. This does not authorize skipping the MXF wire object-wrapper qualification described next.

This differs from the legacy MDB ATTB Kind3/reference wire layout. Bella must keep source-specific wrapper/type/presence status; native category predicate itself has no raw-header Unknown error state.

findings.topic: __AttributeList marker alone is insufficient; valid empty list is meaningful
anchors: GetAttributeList TaggedValue class dispatch0x4dd04..0x4dd1c selects TaggedValueAttributeList0x10e1648
ConvertAttributesFromAAF count0 at0x179f8c..0x179fac ->returns1 at0x17a688; GetAttributeList publishes new list0x4ddf0
findings.evidence: A readable TaggedValue string __AttributeList becomes a native object attribute only after its own nested typed attribute-reference array is successfully read and produces a nonnull AAttrList. Valid empty array can produce an empty list and therefore object presence. Missing/failed wrapper does not satisfy this route. Native general conversion constructs nested attribute lists; the final category predicate does not inspect their settings contents. Bella can preserve existing outer-array/reference validation without decoding individual import-setting semantics or claiming a new marker-only/body-bypass optimization.

findings.topic: PortableObject and damaged forms are separate
anchors: GetObjRefPropFromObject0x17a4fc; PCIDread0x17a528; NewByClassID0x17a53c; object conversion0x17a55c; successful AddObject0x17a580
findings.evidence: Native has a separate PortableObject conversion route using strong object reference and PCID. Unsupported PortableObject cannot be called ordinary string or absence. First Bella release may keep it Unknown, preserving current supported-form limits. Native general import can skip bad entries; Bella should retain unreadable/conflicting necessary evidence rather than turn it into confirmed absence.

findings.topic: Known readable scalar wrong kind versus current conservative MXF support
anchors: CoreFindObject requests kind3 and CoreFindAttr compares actualkind at0x6ccc8
findings.evidence: A readable integer-valued exact _IMPORTSETTING can import as a native numeric attribute; it does not satisfy native object-kind presence. Current MXF adapter conservatively leaves non-string indirect values Unknown, including a supported decoder Int32 value. This is a bounded static difference, not an observed specimen or measured bug. First-release Bella can preserve that supported-form limit; do not claim every valid wrong-kind MXF form is already identical to native or expand it silently.

findings.topic: Direct picture-track count on the same master
anchors: AComponent::GetType0x14748c reads signed16 member+60; compare1 at0x219838
GetAAFComponentProps0x14e778 reads own component DataDefinition;0x14e788 converts to trackkind
aafGetTrackTypeFromDDEF0x22264 picture predicate0x222c0 ->return1 at0x22348; identifier fallback0x223f8
findings.evidence: Count immediate master track components whose imported kind is picture. Do not count file descriptors, physical media files, audio channels, nested picture content, or only the tracks pointing at the current physical file. A master can have two picture tracks while only one points to this physical file. Native loop counts all tracks; early threshold stopping would be a separate implementation choice, not native/current measured performance.

Reuse the already qualified associated TypePrecompute master. Confirm absence from complete unambiguous relevant own attribute/name reads; absent gives Rendered Effects without counting tracks. For present supported object-list wrapper preserve current structural list/reference validation, then establish direct picture-track threshold from supported DataDefinitions. Necessary unreadable/conflicting/unsupported facts leave category Unknown while preserving known Type and file. No automatic PortableObject/null raw reference/unknown DataDefinition expansion. Retain small category enum and availability, labels late, blank unavailable table/CSV with explicit Unknown filter choice. No extra header opening or new source priority. Current pure classifier already exists; no new speed or memory gain measured.

limits: No MC app/private API/decoder or live GUI execution; static bin-display-group proof only.
Category is derived; not Effect Category, Effect, Effect Sequence, alpha codec or timeline membership.
Native general object import builds lists before predicate; predicate body-insensitivity does not eliminate wire wrapper requirements.
Native broad skip/error behavior is not Bella confirmed-absence policy.
No corpus counts or output parity claimed by native audit; wire agent owns actual file evidence.
No runtime/test/build/production edits or measured performance claim.
